**Error response policy** (`policy-error-response.md`, full text):

> # Error response rule
>
> New error responses use the body the app already sends: an object with an errors key that maps a field name to a list of messages, for example {"errors":{"body":["can't be blank"]}}. There is no extra wrapper object.

**Comment ownership:** The closest match is the soft delete rule (`policy-soft-delete.md`, full text):

> # Soft delete rule
>
> Deleting a comment sets a deletedAt timestamp and keeps the row. Comments with a deletedAt value are left out of comment lists. Only the comment author may delete a comment.

**Not-found handling:** The notes do not include a policy on not-found handling, so I can't quote one.
